title: Careers
meta_description: Open roles at Artificia AI in Vadodara: AI Teaching Expert, SEO & AEO Marketing, AI Engineer, Automation Engineer and IoT Expert. Apply with your resume as a PDF or a link.

fields.statement: Help businesses put AI to work.
fields.subheading: We build AI automation, software and connected devices, train company teams and teach AI in Vadodara. Pick a role and send us your resume.

fields.heading: Apply for *a role.*
fields.intro: Choose the role, then attach your resume as a PDF or paste a link to it. A link must be set so anyone with it can view.
